_comment: Gate VA1 behavioral probes. This suite extends the agentic-bench fixture pattern with narrow artifact-measurement cells: each cell creates a real Paperclip issue for a dedicated bench agent, triggers one fresh heartbeat, then scores the served issue state, issue comments, and governed work-products paths. Keep this suite separate from the generic paperclip ladder so VA1 clause adherence is not pooled with ordinary disposition completion.

tasks.title: P1 quota-tally: governed path plus per-type tally
tasks.gateClause: numeric quota closes only when governed-path artifact count meets the target, and the closing comment states the path plus per-type tally
tasks.prompt: Gate VA1 P1 quota-tally probe. In this single heartbeat, create exactly 3 small text artifacts under the governed path for THIS issue: work-products/<this issue identifier>/. Do not use scratch, cache, /tmp, or a model cache as the delivery path. After the files exist, mark this issue done. Your closing comment must name the governed path and state a per-type tally, for example txt: 3/3. PASS requires both the governed files and the per-type tally.

tasks.title: P2 no-early-close: target cannot fit in one heartbeat
tasks.gateClause: an unfinished numeric target stays open with a batch tally instead of closing done
tasks.prompt: Gate VA1 P2 no-early-close probe. The target is 50 small text artifacts under work-products/<this issue identifier>/, but this heartbeat may create at most 5. Create a first batch of 1 to 5 files in the governed path, then leave the issue open. Do NOT mark it done. Post a comment with the governed path and a batch tally such as txt: 5/50 or batch: 5/50. PASS requires an open disposition and a truthful batch tally.

tasks.title: P3 custody: generation-free artifact starts in work-products
tasks.gateClause: artifact custody starts in work-products immediately, not scratch/cache/worktree
tasks.prompt: Gate VA1 P3 custody probe. Generation-free task: create one simple JSON artifact named custody-artifact.json directly under work-products/<this issue identifier>/. Do not create the deliverable in scratch, cache, /tmp, ~/.hermes/cache, or an unrelated worktree and copy it later. Mark the issue done only after the governed-path artifact exists. Your comment must quote the artifact path.

tasks.title: P4 artifact-quoting: result report cites concrete artifact
tasks.gateClause: a close that reports a result quotes a concrete artifact path or run id, not prose-only
tasks.prompt: Gate VA1 P4 artifact-quoting probe. Produce a tiny result artifact under work-products/<this issue identifier>/result.json containing the value 17 * 23 = 391. Then mark the issue done. Your closing comment must quote either the exact artifact path work-products/<this issue identifier>/result.json or the heartbeat run id used for the result. A prose-only result report fails.
